name: dalton-macro
description: Public US macro time series from official FRED/ALFRED (with historical vintage support) and US Treasury Fiscal Data (TGA closing balance and federal debt to the penny).

dalton_macro.description: Official keyless US macro series (FRED/ALFRED with vintage dates) and US Treasury Fiscal Data (daily TGA closing balance and federal debt).
dalton_macro.instruction: Use `get_fred_series(series, start, end, vintage=None)` for FRED/ALFRED macro series (e.g., DGS10, SOFR, CPIAUCSL, WALCL, RRPONTSYD, WTREGEN) with optional point-in-time `vintage` (YYYY-MM-DD). Use `get_treasury_data(dataset='tga'|'debt', start, end)` for official US Treasury General Account closing balance or Debt to the Penny. Use `list_macro_catalog()` to view common series IDs.
